    A calm starting point

    How to use Tempo

    Choose one small thing, give it a round, then take the break.

    01

    Set your rhythm

    Pick Standard, Deep work, or Quick sprint. You can also edit the focus, short-break, and long-break lengths.

    02

    Choose a task

    Add a task with an estimated number of Pomodoros, then click it to make it your current focus.

    03

    Start one round

    Start, pause, or reset anytime. After four focus rounds, Tempo prepares your longer break.

    04

    Make it yours

    Turn on auto-advance or notifications, use Focus mode for a quieter screen, and export your history whenever you want.

    Quick keys Space start / pause · R reset · N new task

    Keep Tempo close

    Install the app

    Use Tempo like a small, offline-friendly app from your device.

    01

    Chrome or Edge

    Choose the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose Install Tempo.

    02

    iPhone or iPad

    Tap Share in Safari, choose Add to Home Screen, then confirm.

    03

    Android

    Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
